info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Connects API
Shopify Connects An Inventory Item To A Location By Creating An Inventory Level At That Location

params.name:
inventory_item_id
                  required
params.description: The ID of the inventory item.

params.name:
location_id
                  required
params.description: The ID of the location that the inventory level belongs to. To find the ID of the location, use the Location resource.

params.name: relocate_if_necessary
params.description:
Whether inventory for any previously connected locations will be relocated. This property is ignored when no fulfillment service location is involved. For more information, see Inventory levels and fulfillment service locations.
                  (default: false)
